I need to find which single function or method declared under /bench/repo/internal/ has the highest inbound-call count (fan-in) across the entire codebase. I need the exact function name, file path, line number, and approximate caller count.

Step 1: List all exported functions/methods in internal/ packages. Focus on extracting function names from all .go files under /bench/repo/internal/.

Step 2: For each candidate (especially from util, base, filter, markdown, profile, and other packages), grep -r across the whole repo to count how many times each function is called.

Step 3: Report the top candidates ranked by call count.

Be very thorough. Use grep -rn with word boundaries to count references. Exclude the definition file itself when counting. Look at ALL internal packages, not just the ones I listed. Report exact file paths and line numbers for the definitions, and exact grep hit counts.

content.text: Good, now I have 89 exported functions. Let me count references for each one across the entire codebase, excluding the definition file.

input.command:
# For each exported function, count grep hits across the whole repo (excluding definition)
# First, build a mapping of function -> definition file
declare -A FUNC_FILE
while IFS=: read -r file line rest; do
  fname=$(echo "$rest" | sed -E 's/^func (\([^)]*\) )?([A-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)\(.*/\2/')
  if [[ "$fname" =~ ^[A-Z] ]]; then
    FUNC_FILE["$fname"]="$file"
  fi
done < <(find /bench/repo/internal/ -type f -name "*.go" ! -name "*_test.go" -exec grep -n '^func ' {} +)

# Now count for each function
for func in $(echo "${!FUNC_FILE[@]}" | tr ' ' '\n' | sort); do
  deffile="${FUNC_FILE[$func]}"
  # Count references in all .go files excluding the definition file
  count=$(grep -rn --include="*.go" "\b${func}\b" /bench/repo/ | grep -v "^${deffile}:" | wc -l)
  if [ "$count" -gt 0 ]; then
    echo "$count $func $deffile"
  fi
done | sort -rn | head -40
input.description: Count references for each exported function across entire repo
